# UIAD validation fixture

`uiad-v2.json` is SAP's public AFF schema at commit
[`7bb8a111760f6d5e597e6d08c31110a7aafc6035`](https://github.com/SAP/abap-file-formats/blob/7bb8a111760f6d5e597e6d08c31110a7aafc6035/file-formats/uiad/uiad-v2.json).
It is test data, not a runtime fallback. Runtime validation fetches the current target's full schema.
